method: Existing Adaptive Naming System v0.4.0 with Owner-feedback-as-labels, broad construction portfolio, practical-screening cadence
purpose: Increase candidate supply without treating Controller quality judgments as a second Owner-quality standard. Owner feedback remains the authoritative quality label; this batch is internal until practical screening.

label_policy.controller_intrinsic_review: triage/filter only, not a substitute for Owner judgment
label_policy.positive_reference_use: comparison/control only; no literal morphology seeding

positive_brief.object: Long-term umbrella organization for research, education, software/tools, publishing, public knowledge and creation.
positive_brief.value_relation: Shared knowledge supports independent perspective and creation; contributions can return to shared knowledge without forcing uniform interpretation.
positive_brief.identity_goal: Memorable, credible, ownable organization-level identity with room for many projects.
positive_brief.owner_signals: Meaning matters; compact spoken effort and orderly visual contour are soft preferences; stable/dependable with restrained cleverness; avoid repeated morphology and high listening/spelling burden.
positive_brief.screening_cadence: Fast intrinsic triage -> exact/material identity -> .com -> lightweight public trademark signal -> Owner batch. Deep multi-jurisdiction work only for strong/high-value survivors after Owner response or when a concrete risk lead requires it.
